articles.title: Supply of 40 Airbus aircraft to Defence Ministry taxable; AAR says Gujarat GST registration required
articles.summary: Airbus must obtain GST registration in Gujarat to supply aircraft to the Indian Defence Ministry, as ruled by the Gujarat AAR. This decision impacts a significant defence procurement project involving the Tata group, which is assembling aircraft for Airbus in its Gujarat plant. This highlights crucial tax compliance within major defence acquisitions and collaborative manufacturing efforts in India.
